entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, thank you for calling VeloFit. You're speaking with Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex. I'd like to start a return for an order I received recently.
I can certainly help you with that. Do you have the order number handy?

Thank you. Let me pull that up. I see the order for the Pro-Frame helmet, delivered 16 days ago. To make sure I'm handling this correctly, is it a technical fault with the helmet or more of a personal preference?
It's just a preference. The color wasn't what I expected from the pictures online. The box is still unopened, I haven't even touched it.

I completely understand. Not a problem at all. Your helmet is a standard item, so it falls within our 90-day return policy. I've just approved the return and sent a prepaid shipping label to the email address on your account.

Oh, that's great. Thanks for making that so easy. Since I do plan on ordering a different helmet, would it be possible to get a small discount code for my next purchase, just for the trouble of sending this one back?

I understand the request, but our policy doesn't allow for discount codes on returns due to a color preference. However, I can assure you that once we receive the original item, your refund will be processed within 24 hours so you can get the right gear. We want to make sure you're happy with both the fit and the safety features of your new helmet.
Okay, that's fair. I figured it was worth asking. Thanks for sending the label over so quickly.
You're very welcome! Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Happy to help. Thanks for calling VeloFit, and have a great day!
